Headline: Fishmeal for European fish farms traced to West African waters
Author: Karin Holm
Body: A new investigation published today alleges that fishmeal destined for European aquaculture feed is being produced from fish caught in West African waters that local communities rely on for food. The report names several processing plants and traces shipments to feed producers in northern Europe. Investigators documented catch volumes over eighteen months and compared them against export manifests obtained from port authorities.

Headline: Nordic feed buyers question fishmeal origin after report
Author: Sofie Bruun
Body: Feed producers across the Nordic region are facing renewed questions from buyers about the provenance of the fishmeal in their aquaculture feed. Several retailers have asked suppliers to confirm the origin of raw material following the publication of the report earlier this week, and at least one certification body has said it is reviewing its standards.

Headline: Fishmeal origin questioned by Nordic feed buyers after report
Author: Staff Reporter
Body: Buyers across the Nordic feed sector are asking new questions about where the fishmeal in aquaculture feed originates. Retailers have written to suppliers seeking confirmation of raw material origin after this week's report, and a certification body has confirmed it is reviewing its own standards in response to the findings.
